shared_elements: rows or fields of repeated linear/geometric signs
short vertical strokes and chevron-like marks
justification: The main overlap is that both surfaces include repeated incised-looking linear signs, including short strokes and angular/chevron-like marks arranged in rows or bands. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by large, recognizable profile animals and separated pictorial registers, while A appears primarily as a dense field of small abstract or script-like marks with no comparable animal-centered scene.
